influences.name: Grace Slick
influences.context: During an interview, Welch cited Grace Slick of Jefferson Airplane as her influence and "hero".

influences.name: Kate Bush
influences.context: My icons were always women like Kate Bush, Stevie Nicks and Siouxsie Sioux. Who wouldn't be proud to carry on that tradition?
